page.overview:
Who is Saroiya Farseen?

Saroiya Farseen is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the White Ajah.

She is blocky/stocky but looks slim compared to Aledrin Malenry. She is 5'4" or 153cm tall. She has brown hair and brown eyes.,Saroiya Farseen|comp}} She has the habit of tugging her ear when in deep thought. She is extraordinarily patient. According to Romanda Cassin, when Saroiya starts grinding her teeth, most sisters would be shouting.

Saroiya is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Saroiya is 143 years old. She was born in Arad Doman in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending thirteen years as novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
